nodes.label: You Don't Need to Run Every Eval
nodes.author: Yuchen Zeng, Dimitris Papailiopoulos
nodes.rationale: Proposes BENCHPRESS, a rank-2 matrix completion method for predicting LLM benchmark scores from sparse public evaluation data. Core insight: frontier model benchmark scores exhibit low-rank structure, enabling score prediction from small probe sets.

nodes.label: BENCHPRESS Score Predictor
nodes.rationale: Logit-transformed, bias-decomposed alternating least squares (ALS) matrix completion with rank 2 and regularization λ=0.1. Selected as default predictor after evaluating 84 transform-method combinations.

nodes.label: 84×133 Frontier Model Score Matrix
nodes.rationale: Public benchmark score matrix: 84 models, 133 benchmarks, 2,604 observed cells (23.3% fill). Curated from vendor reports, leaderboards, and third-party sources. Exhibits rank-2 geometry.

nodes.label: Rank-2 Geometry of Score Matrix
nodes.rationale: Empirical finding: held-out rank sweep minimizes error at rank 2; SVD of fully-observed submatrices shows two factors explain >90% variance. PC1 captures general capability; PC2 separates domains (coding vs. math).

nodes.label: Soft-Impute Matrix Completion
nodes.author: Mazumder et al., 2010
nodes.rationale: Baseline matrix completion method: alternates between SVD truncation at chosen rank and reimputation of missing entries. Used to establish rank-2 optimality.

nodes.label: Bias-Decomposed ALS
nodes.author: Koren et al., 2009
nodes.rationale: Matrix factorization with global level, model offsets, benchmark offsets, and rank-R residual interaction. Fits U∈ℝ^(M×R) and V∈ℝ^(B×R) via ridge regression on observed entries.

nodes.label: Greedy Probe Set Selection
nodes.rationale: Greedy algorithm selects benchmark probes to minimize pooled prediction error. Five-probe set (GPQA-D, HLE, Codeforces, MMLU-Pro, ARC-AGI-1) recovers scorecard to 3.93 MedAE; cost-aware variant reaches 4.55.

nodes.label: Pairwise Model Ranking Preservation
nodes.rationale: BENCHPRESS predictions preserve 92.1% of pairwise model rankings on same benchmark when true score gap ≥5 points. Margin-aware evaluation accounts for near-ties.

nodes.label: Temporal Deployment Stress Test
nodes.rationale: Evaluates BENCHPRESS on 27 newly released models using only pre-release training matrix. Five seed scores yield 4.83 MedAE; ten seeds tighten to 2.57 points.

nodes.label: Hybrid Reliability Estimator
nodes.rationale: Combines ensemble-spread disagreement and matrix-support signals to estimate per-cell prediction risk. Identifies safe-to-use predictions; when keeping 20% lowest-risk cells, MedAE drops to 1.83 points.

nodes.label: Benchmark-Side Prediction Factors
nodes.rationale: Three factors jointly affect benchmark predictability: wider score spread increases error (H3), more observed model scores reduce error (H4), strong-neighbor presence reduces error (H5). Tested via Spearman correlation and paired Wilcoxon ablations.

nodes.label: Model-Side Prediction Factors
nodes.rationale: Five factors affect model predictability: reasoning models easier than non-reasoning (H2), higher-scoring models easier (H3), strong-peer presence helps (H5), more observations help (H8), recent training anchors help (H9).

nodes.label: Logit Feature Transform
nodes.rationale: Transform percentage scores s ∈ [0,100] via log(s/(100-s)). Maps bounded range to unbounded scale, symmetrically spreading apart scores near 0 and 100. Selected as best feature transform for BENCHPRESS.

nodes.label: HELM Leaderboard
nodes.author: Liang et al., 2023
nodes.rationale: Independent score matrix source. BENCHPRESS tested on 83×207 HELM matrix (9,776 cells). Achieves 2.87 MedAE, outperforming baselines.

nodes.label: Every Eval Ever (EEE)
nodes.author: Batzner et al., 2026
nodes.rationale: Independent score matrix source. BENCHPRESS tested on 653×498 EEE matrix (24,879 cells). Achieves 2.89 MedAE, validating generalization.

nodes.label: Conformal Prediction Intervals
nodes.rationale: Calibrated 90% prediction intervals for BENCHPRESS predictions. Hybrid estimator produces 27.01 point median width at 90% coverage. Intervals sharpen as more scores observed.
